hardwareProjects.title: Arduino Closed-Loop PID Temperature Control System
hardwareProjects.description: Implemented a closed-loop thermal regulation system on an Arduino microcontroller utilizing classical PID control algorithms.
hardwareProjects.fullDetails: Developed for the Linear Control Systems Course at SSUET (Feb 2026 – June 2026). Implemented a closed-loop thermal regulation system on an Arduino microcontroller utilizing classical PID control algorithms. Key Technical Contributions: - Calibrated temperature sensor inputs and managed heating element power switching via Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) drivers. - Experimentally tuned proportional (Kp), integral (Ki), and derivative (Kd) gains to eliminate steady-state error and optimize transient response under dynamic thermal loads.
